label: Leader
description: Led the thing the event is about, without a named office to say so.

label: Head of state
description: The king, president or equivalent, acting as such.

label: Head of government
description: The prime minister or equivalent, acting as such.

label: Minister
description: Held a department and acted through it.

label: Commander
description: Commanded the force involved.

label: Government
description: The state, regime or administration whose act this was.

label: Opposition
description: Stood against it, lost by it, or was excluded from it.

label: Party
description: A party that stood, won seats, or joined a coalition.

label: Candidate
description: Stood for the office at issue.

label: Elected
description: Won the vote, the seat or the admission.

label: Appointed
description: Was put in place by somebody else rather than elected.

label: Deposed
description: Was removed from power by the event.

label: Resigned
description: Left office by their own act.

label: Belligerent
description: Fought in it, on either side.

label: Invader
description: Crossed into or annexed somebody else's ground.

label: Occupier
description: Held ground it had taken.

label: Victim
description: Was killed, injured or dispossessed by it.

label: Perpetrator
description: Did the killing or the harm, or is said to have.

label: Target
description: The thing or person the act was aimed at.

label: Signatory
description: Signed the agreement.

label: Negotiator
description: Negotiated it without necessarily signing it.

label: Creditor
description: Lent the money or set the terms of the loan.

label: Debtor
description: Borrowed it and owed it.

label: Supporter
description: Backed, funded or patronised it without being party to it.

label: Founder
description: Founded the thing the event brought into existence.

label: Member
description: Joined it, or was the body joined.

label: Applicant
description: Asked to be admitted.

label: Host
description: Held the occasion on its own ground.

label: Author
description: Wrote or drafted the text at issue.

label: Movement
description: A movement or front acting as one, without a party's shape.

label: Institution
description: A body acting in its institutional capacity — a bank, a church, an army, a court.
